title: Image Color Picker
keywords: pick hex rgb hsl & hsv colors
about: Sample colors from image pixels and inspect their HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV values using the local browser canvas workspace.
steps: Move or position the picker over the pixel or area you want to sample.
Read the displayed HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV values.
Copy the color value you need using the workspace control, if available.
Repeat for other points in the image.
capabilities: The tool samples decoded image pixels through local Canvas pixel access and displays common color representations.
benefits: This workflow can make image color picker tasks more direct by keeping the relevant controls in one browser workspace. Review the exported result before using it in another application or service.
limitations: Color sampling can be affected by image color profiles, browser decoding, transparency, and display differences. Treat sampled values as values from the decoded browser image.

faqs.question: What does Image Color Picker do?
faqs.answer: Sample colors from image pixels and inspect their HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV values using the local browser canvas workspace.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my image?
faqs.answer: The registered method for this tool is browser-based. Check the current privacy notice and the visible workspace behavior before using sensitive files.

faqs.question: How can I check the result?
faqs.answer: Review the preview and open the downloaded file in its intended destination. For dimensions or metadata, use a suitable image properties or metadata viewer.
